messages:
talia: quick flag  new preview shows broken anchors and a few missing images in the examples section
ben: can you paste one example link?
talia: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/js/examples/ -> notebook diagram 404 at /static/notebooks/runner.png but the built html references /assets/notebooks/runner.png
ari: sounds like the asset copy step didn't update to the new theme 'static/' location after the mkdocs migration
ben: minimal plan: (1) add a normalize step in the build to move examples -> static/notebooks, (2) run a small sed pass to rewrite /assets/ -> /static/ in generated html, (3) add an anchor-compat test for slug stability
talia: i'll open a cleanup PR to fix notebook references to use relative paths and add language tags to code blocks that broke mobile rendering
ari: i'll add the normalize script and a pytest linkcheck that follows intra-page anchors. docs-bot: note: big rebuilds may exceed nightly CI quota :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ben: if CI passes we'll schedule a quiet deploy tomorrow 05:30 UTC and monitor 30m; rollback plan ready
talia: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-ai/docs/pull/4220 (normalize) and https://github.com/redwood-ai/docs/pull/4221 (notebook cleanup)
docs-bot: preview build queued, ETA ~10m
